summary: Our project is called Severance. It is a space exploration device designed to travel to Mars and search for possible signs of life. We developed this device to help scientists explore the Martian surface, collect information, and investigate whether conditions for life exist on the planet. Severance addresses the challenge by using scientific exploration and technology to study Mars and gather important data. This project is important because understanding Mars can help us learn more about the possibility of life beyond Earth, the history of our solar system, and the future of space exploration.
details:
Severance is a space exploration device designed to explore Mars and search for possible signs of life. It works by examining the Martian environment and collecting information that could help scientists understand the planet better. Its main benefits are supporting scientific research, exploring new possibilities, and helping humanity learn more about life beyond Earth.

The intended impact of Severance is to contribute to future space exploration and improve our understanding of Mars. Our project was developed using mathematical knowledge, scientific research, creativity, and teamwork. We considered important factors such as the Martian environment, temperature, terrain, and the challenges of exploring another planet.

Severance is creative because it combines science, technology, and mathematics in an innovative idea to explore one of the most interesting questions in science: Is there life beyond Earth?
